title: Not responding message happens a lot
symptom: The xDrip app frequently freezes for long durations and takes a very long time for the menu button to appear when loading, showing a 'not responding' notification.
cause: The sensor was started a year ago, making database operations for the current sensor much slower.
fix: Stop and restart the sensor to make database operations for the current sensor much quicker.
evidence_quote: Try stopping and restarting it. Should make DB operations for "current sensor" much quicker.
